title: Four new plugins, Quest buttons and safer safe mode
notes: New plugins (from Equicord): Save Favorite GIFs (type /savegifs to save your favourite GIFs to a text file), Voice Rejoin (rejoins your voice channel after Discord restarts), Wait For Slot (joins a full voice channel when a place frees up) and Never Pause Previews (stream previews keep moving when Discord is not focused).
Quests: new Start All and Stop All buttons on the Quests page, and fixes to quest enrollment and the quest button menu.
Safe mode no longer counts a normal close of Discord as a failure, and the Settings page has a way to leave it.
More Alts: the Manage Accounts window follows the new Discord build.

title: More Alts in the account window, and a Server Search button
notes: More Alts works: the Manage Accounts window now lets you add more accounts than Discord's own five (the limit is set in the plugin's settings).
New Server Search plugin (from Equicord): a search button under the Home button opens Discord's quick switcher. It turns on and off without restarting Discord.
New pieces for plugin authors: plugins can draw things in the server list and add slash commands.

title: Badges on profiles
notes: New Badges plugin: people who use Amiricord see an Amiricord User badge on each other's profiles, and the owners have an Owner badge.
The owners can hand out their own badges with a list kept in the project's repository.

Amiricord tells the project's registry (a small free service, only the id of your Discord account) that you use it, and reads the list of Amiricord users every two hours, so everyone gets the badge without doing anything. It is always on: it is how Amiricord users recognise each other.
The plugin also adds an invisible mark to your own pronouns, as a second way to be recognised.
It reads the owners' badge list from GitHub when Discord starts and every 30 minutes. The plugin windows now show the Discord name and picture of each author.

title: Updates inside Amiricord, and a round of fixes
notes: New Updates tab: press Check for updates and, when there is a newer version, Update now. Amiricord installs it and asks to restart Discord.
Copy Media Link works: right-click a picture or GIF and choose it at the end of the menu.
Copy Status URLs works with the buttons of someone's status (a game or app with its own buttons, not Spotify's).
GifTransfer has a Delete all button, and its buttons match Discord's look.
More Alts works again in the current Discord: more than five accounts in the account switcher.
DeleteMe tells you why a scan found nothing to delete.
New plugins: GifCaptioner, DeleteMe, MoreAlts, Copy Status URLs and Copy Media Link.
